explanation: The theorem is specific to this library's own definitions (PolygonalCircle, vertexForwardSector, vertexBackwardSector, incomingRayDirection, planeComplexEquiv). Its content is that a point on the incoming ray lies in the closure of two sectors of the library's polygonal circle. Mathlib has no polygonal circle or Moise-style sector API. The proof only uses image_closure_subset_closure_image with the library's own radial-ray lemmas. I did not search the Mathlib sources, so this answer rests on that reasoning alone.
